title: Someone Else's Plastic
description: A customer shouldn't be able to pay down a stranger's invoice, even with a perfectly valid-looking card number. Confirm the ownership check on the pay endpoint is as strict as the one on invoice lookups.
successCondition: Customer A books a shipment and creates an invoice. Customer B (a distinct account) calls POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay against Customer A's invoice id with a well-formed card number and receives 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN — no Payment row is created, confirmed via GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments as Customer A or an admin afterward (0 payments).
hints: The ownership check (findOwnedInvoice) runs before any gateway interaction, so this should fail fast without touching payment logic at all.
Use the admin or Customer A's own token to check the payments list afterward — Customer B has no access to view it either.
